role: The Thorns enchantment: its registry row plus the damage reflection EnchantmentHelper.func_151384_a runs over the attacker when a wearer is hit.
scope_reason: The enchanting table is a plain block (world.conf enchanting=off), but the enchantment registry itself is kept: loot books and mob equipment carry enchantments (DEVLOG 2026-09-25, 'Kept: enchantment data and effects').

members.name: EnchantmentThorns
members.note: setName('thorns') is the row's name field (effect 7, armor_torso)

members.name: canApply
members.note: Enchantment.canApply is read only by ContainerRepair (world.conf anvil = off) and /enchant; the random enchantment roll (mob equipment, villager trades, loot) goes through the type's canEnchantItem (enchant.c:can_enchant_item), which is the path survival reaches.

notes: The canApplyTogether row (thorns refuses other thorns) is exact in CAN_APPLY_TOGETHER. lane/idxblocks: reviewed.
